fields.description: current when the content holds; revised when it was changed for the trigger; needs-change when it is stale and was not changed, so it stays due.
fields.name: outcome

fields.description: The reviewed bytes: hash (sha256) and bytes, and commit for a document of another repository.
fields.name: content

fields.description: The covered paths' content identity when reviewed, for a document with a covers trigger; required to clear one.
fields.name: covered

fields.description: The triggers this review answers: on, and the record that fired it for release, upgrade, decision and accepted; may be empty.
fields.name: answers

fields.description: self when the reviewer revised the content, or, for a document of another repository, states that it wrote it; independent-agent for another agent; operator for the operator.
fields.name: independence

fields.description: What was checked.
fields.name: summary

fields.description: severity (error|warning|info), summary, optional location; may be empty.
fields.name: findings

fields.description: The declared checks that ran: name, outcome (passed|failed|skipped|not-performed), summary; a failed check refuses the clearance; may be empty.
fields.name: checks

fields.description: Exact section reviews: id, hash, sourceDigest, outcome, fidelity (sketch|draft|final), sources (id, kind, identity, hash, bytes, status and exact records), checks and per-rule cohesion verdicts. Evaluator judgments name their exact evidence hashes and require independence. A section review clears no other section.
fields.name: sections

types.name: document-review
types.summary: Clears a due living document, or finds it stale: the reviewed content by hash (and commit for another repository), the covered paths' identity, the triggers it answers, the checks that ran, and the reviewer's independence of the content.

fields.description: Repository-relative path under design/ or docs/; format 3 also admits README.md for the estate's template instance.
fields.name: path

fields.description: Document title.
fields.name: title

fields.description: sha256 of the file bytes.
fields.name: hash

fields.description: File size in bytes.
fields.name: bytes

fields.description: For example text/markdown.
fields.name: mediaType

fields.description: 1 for the first revision; later revisions supersede the previous record.
fields.name: revision

fields.description: What this revision is or changes.
fields.name: summary

types.name: document-revision
types.summary: Pins a design or docs file at an exact content hash and revision number; editing the file requires a new revision record.

fields.description: The document's repository-relative path; required unless format 3 supplies pathPattern.
fields.name: path

fields.description: For generated documents only: a literal directory followed by {month}/{date}-{slug}-{id}.md. Exclusive with path; members come from exact source revisions.
fields.name: pathPattern

fields.description: The resource record of the repository that holds it; absent for the estate's own repository.
fields.name: repository

fields.description: The document's title.
fields.name: title

fields.description: authored by a person or an agent, or generated from its inputs.
fields.name: kind

fields.description: For a generated document, required: id (such as vericairn.mcp/orientation) and inputs (string[]).
fields.name: generator

fields.description: How its content is read at a revision: estate-file, or a pack's source such as vericairn.software/git-file.
fields.name: source

fields.description: Nonempty for authored and legacy declarations; strict format-3 whole generated declarations allow an empty list. Each trigger has on, level (remind|warn|refuse), and its declared inputs.
fields.name: triggers

fields.description: Generated regions: id, generator and optionally its inputs (string[]); marked <!-- vericairn:generated <id> --> and <!-- vericairn:end <id> --> in the document.
fields.name: regions

fields.description: Who may clear it: any admitted principal (the default), independent (not the one that revised or wrote its content), or operator.
fields.name: clearedBy

fields.description: Checks run at each clearance: names-version, matches-generator, links-resolve, or a pack's named namespace/name.
fields.name: checks

fields.description: Why it is living: the facts it states.
fields.name: summary

fields.description: An exact template instance: id, version, hash, owner, optional scope (domain, product, project), all effective options and overrides (section, action, reason, and heading, definition or exact decision as applicable). Templates grant nothing.
fields.name: template

fields.description: An owner's explicit version choice: offered (id, version, hash), outcome (accepted|declined), reason. Acceptance revises the pin; decline preserves it.
fields.name: templateUpgrade

types.name: living-document
types.summary: Declares a living document: its path and repository, whether it is authored or generated, the triggers that make it due and at which level (remind, warn or refuse), its generated regions, its checks and who may clear it.

fields.description: What was observed; estate requires record format 2, a human author and an exact estate subject.
fields.name: kind

fields.description: When the observation was made.
fields.name: asOf

fields.description: The observation in a sentence.
fields.name: summary

fields.description: Flat facts: strings, numbers, booleans or arrays of strings; never machine paths. An estate observation requires records (count), recordSetHash, pinHash and statusHash. An operator-request observation requires outcome (done), destination, location and evidenceHash, and its signed exact request subject. Format-3 package facts pin provider, product, productHash, package and version, with either release and releaseHash or reserved (the same version declared reserved in that exact product, with no release pins). The subject is the exact release, reserved product declaration or original account-holder intent.
fields.name: facts

fields.description: What the observation does not establish; may be empty.
fields.name: limitations

fields.description: For package observations: exact public registry url, response-body hash, HTTP status, byte count and content encoding for each response; hashes cover bytes before gzip decoding.
fields.name: evidence

types.name: observation
types.summary: Something reported or measured about an exact subject with an as-of time: a repository, release or workflow run; from record format 2, a person's explicit observation of an estate; from format 3, package registry state with response evidence. Facts, never permission or health.

fields.description: Exact prompt source, key, revision/version, hash, definition, placeholder values and rendered comment. Authority is unchanged. Kept in run and decision revisions.
fields.name: promptUse

fields.description: The provider the operation goes through, for example github-releases.
fields.name: provider

fields.description: The declared operation, for example dispatch-release-workflow.
fields.name: action

fields.description: The original identity the effect is reconciled under; unique among current operations.
fields.name: identity

fields.description: The intended effect, in a sentence.
fields.name: intent

fields.description: Where the effect lands: repository, workflow, ref, version, product; for an agent run, its assignment, its principal, its workspace (a repository and branch, never a machine path), the goal it is charged to, the worker contract and, for a run launched under it, the sponsor's custody exception (custodyException); string values only. Format-3 package actions pin provider, product, productHash, package and version, with either release and releaseHash or reserved (the same version declared reserved in that exact product, with no release pins); the subject pins that release or product declaration.
fields.name: target

fields.description: not-started, dispatched, observed-success, known-failure, canceled or uncertain.
fields.name: status

fields.description: When the dispatch was made; required once dispatched. Account-holder package actions never claim a dispatch and omit this field.
fields.name: dispatchedAt

fields.description: summary, at, optional url and reference: what was observed; required for observed-success and known-failure.
fields.name: observed

fields.description: How an uncertain or failed outcome was settled before a retry; required when a retry is dispatched.
fields.name: reconciliation

fields.description: summary, optional hash and location; may be empty.
fields.name: evidence

fields.description: For repository changes: name, head, status and optional conclusion for every reported check. A merge admits only successful checks of its exact head.
fields.name: checks

fields.description: The exact check names from the pinned product declaration; none guessed.
fields.name: requiredChecks

fields.description: For a push: tool, version, range, verdict and optional findingCount. Only aggregate scan facts; never matched text, findings or process output.
fields.name: scan

fields.description: For an agent-run: what the run may spend, recorded before it starts and kept in every revision; wallMinutes is required. A run that names its goal starts only while the goal is active, with the units its budget grants, within what remains of them, its concurrency and its attempts per step. Units: wallMinutes, attemptsPerStep, tokens and concurrency (positive integers) and currency ({amount in minor units, unit: three upper-case letters}); an absent unit is not an unlimited one.
fields.name: cap

fields.description: For an agent-run once settled: what it spent as the harness reported it, and the units its cap states that were not reported (unreported), which are charged at the cap.
fields.name: usage

fields.description: Worker scope audit at settlement: changed count, outsideCount, repository-relative outside paths (at most 1000), and optional problem when incomplete. Outside changes need attention, never acceptance.
fields.name: scope

fields.description: Worker-observed event-stream liveness: stallSeconds, lastEventAt, and optional attentionAt, attention (ask id), stoppedAt. Attention at one silence limit; stop at two.
fields.name: liveness

fields.description: Worker event-stream and settlement observations: code, severity (warning|critical), at, summary, optional fingerprint, count and attention (ask id). Raw invocation inputs never enter a record.
fields.name: signals

fields.description: Immutable admitted model, effort, provenance, disabled Adapter, environment inventory and context allocation, recorded before dispatch.
fields.name: execution

fields.description: Harness reports at settlement, with discrepancies and facts still unknown; never inferred from the request.
fields.name: executionObserved

fields.description: For an agent-run that was stopped: requestedAt and requestedBy (a principal, or worker for a cap the run reached), optional reason, then each fact once observed: transmittedAt with transmission, acknowledgedAt with acknowledgment, escalatedAt with escalation, and containedAt, only in a settled revision. A stop not observed stays requested.
fields.name: stop

types.name: operation
types.summary: An intended external effect with an original identity: recorded as not-started before any dispatch, then dispatched, observed-success, known-failure, canceled or uncertain, each as a superseding revision. One current operation per identity; a retry after an uncertain or failed outcome names its reconciliation. The transport response is not the effect.

fields.description: Product name.
fields.name: name

fields.description: Identifier.
fields.name: slug

fields.description: The product in a sentence.
fields.name: summary

fields.description: name, slug, summary, optional license (SPDX expression).
fields.name: editions

fields.description: name, slug, summary: runtime, Workbench, Remote, CLI, SDK, websites.
fields.name: surfaces

fields.description: Checked repository changes: provider, repository resource id, target branch and requiredChecks (exact host check names, including each required platform). An empty or absent declaration authorizes no merge.
fields.name: changes

fields.description: Registry observations: provider (nuget-org), ids (one to sixteen distinct NuGet package ids), and optional reserved (one to eight distinct NuGet placeholder versions, none recorded as a release of this product). Reserved versions pin this declaration without a release. Account holders perform registry changes.
fields.name: packages

fields.description: How the product's releases are made: destination (provider id and its settings, string values), checksums (the asset that lists the others' hashes) and artifacts (name with {version} and optionally {platform}, role distributable|sbom|notices|documentation|other, platforms). Read by release 0.4.2, the first published release to read it, and later (0.4.0, which introduced it, was withdrawn).
fields.name: release

types.name: product
types.summary: A product the estate owns: name, summary, editions and surfaces, and optionally how its releases are made (the destination and the artifacts a complete release carries). Details live in design documents.

fields.description: completed when the brief's outcome was produced; partial when usable work exists but the outcome was not reached; blocked or abandoned otherwise.
fields.name: outcome

fields.description: What was done and what changed.
fields.name: summary

fields.description: name, hash (sha256 of the bytes), optional bytes, mediaType and location (repository-relative; verified when the file is present); may be empty. From format 3 an optional section contains id and document (an exact living-document reference); hash and bytes then identify that section's payload.
fields.name: outputs

fields.description: summary, optional hash and location; may be empty.
fields.name: evidence

fields.description: name, outcome (passed|failed|skipped|not-performed), summary; may be empty.
fields.name: checks

fields.description: What the result does not establish; may be empty.
fields.name: limitations

fields.description: External effects whose outcome is not known and must be reconciled before any retry; may be empty.
fields.name: unresolvedEffects

fields.description: The next permitted step for whoever continues, or 'none'.
fields.name: nextStep

fields.description: Exact originating policy, rule, tagged occurrence, examined subject, scope, coverage and supporting proof bindings. This is a signed claim, not acceptance.
fields.name: duties

types.name: result
types.summary: What an attempt submits: outcome, summary, outputs by hash, evidence, checks performed or not, limitations, unresolved external effects and the next permitted step. A claim to inspect; acceptance is a separate record pinned to this exact result.

fields.description: The exact content pin: id (namespace/name), version (semantic version) and hash (canonical SHA-256).
fields.name: template

fields.description: kind (estate|domain|product|project), and target for every kind except estate. One current declaration per template version and scope.
fields.name: scope

fields.description: Allowed option choices: template option ids, or section-id.option-id and field-id.option-id, mapped to string values. Unspecified values inherit wider defaults.
fields.name: options

fields.description: Why this adoption scope uses these defaults. Recording them assigns no role and grants no authority.
fields.name: reason

types.name: template-defaults
types.summary: Option defaults for an exact template version at estate, domain, product or project scope. Narrower scopes win when an instance is created; existing instances keep their recorded choices.
